c42129f7-fa62-44db-94fa-7f9570f6b14d/Eve.en: The evil corruption of Xiangshu had permeated deep into <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s mind and spirit,<NL>and despite being the <color=#E3C66DFF>Successor of Taiwu</color>, they ultimately fell into the corrupted path and became a fiendish underling of Xiangshu...<NL>At the brink of their insanity, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> channeled the lifelong power into the <color=#E3C66DFF>Fuyu Hilt</color> with their last shred of clarity...<NL>Yet with no one left to inherit the Hilt, all they could do was leave behind a letter in sorrow, explaining the origins of the <color=#E3C66DFF>Fuyu Hilt</color> and the lineage of the <color=#E3C66DFF>Successor of Taiwu</color>.<NL>With no other choice, they hoped that someday, someone may still be able to carry on Taiwu's legacy by following the clues within this letter of last words and wielding the Hilt...<NL><NL>However, time flies with no mercy, and hundreds and thousands of years have swiftly passed.<NL>Without Taiwu's checks, Xiangshu could now roam free in the human world, raining atrocities everywhere. No longer would any land be peaceful in the world,<NL>for all its dwellers are either evils or viles. The <color=#E3C66DFF>Fuyu Hilt</color> and the <color=#E3C66DFF>Taiwu's Last Letter</color> were deeply buried underground, and the name <color=#E3C66DFF>Taiwu</color> was no longer known to anyone...

5493fd10-1722-4a3e-9cb7-d314fb022526/Eve.cn: 即将疯癫之际，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />唤来可以托付<color=#E3C66DFF>「伏虞剑柄」</color>与<color=#E3C66DFF>「太吾」</color>姓氏之人，<NL>向其言明太吾之遗志与剑柄的奥秘。<NL><NL>而后，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />凭着最后一丝理智，<NL>将毕生的功力化入<color=#E3C66DFF>「伏虞剑柄」</color>之中……<NL><NL><color=#8E8E8EFF>（继承者将成为太吾氏新的传人，继承与相枢世世为敌、至死方休的宿命。<NL>继承者受传伏虞剑柄的同时，虽然继承者原本的内力、功法将被废去，但也会同时获得历代太吾累积于伏虞剑柄之中的功力以及诸般学识与造诣。）</color>

d09c198b-a293-4270-8c60-ec2b970217f9/Eve.en: On the verge of losing the mind, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> channeled the lifelong power<NL>into the <color=#E3C66DFF>Fuyu Hilt</color> with the last vestige of sanity.<NL>Yet with no one left nearby to inherit the Hilt, all that could be done was to leave behind a letter in sorrow,<NL>explaining the origins of the <color=#E3C66DFF>Fuyu Hilt</color> and the lineage of the <color=#E3C66DFF>Successor of Taiwu</color>.<NL>With no other choice, they hoped that someday, someone may still be able to carry on Taiwu's legacy by following the clues within this letter of last words and wielding the Hilt...
d09c198b-a293-4270-8c60-ec2b970217f9/Eve.cn: 即将疯癫之际，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />凭着最后一丝理智，将毕生的功力化入<color=#E3C66DFF>「伏虞剑柄」</color>之中，<NL>但因身边无人可传，只得含泪留下书信，<NL>说明<color=#E3C66DFF>「伏虞剑柄」</color>与<color=#E3C66DFF>「太吾传人」</color>之始末，<NL>盼望有朝一日，仍能有人凭剑柄与遗书继承太吾的遗志……

e5c331da-ec32-482c-bba2-efa53d7396c4/Eve.en: As the old saying goes: "With intent but no form, form arises from intent; with form but no intent, form fades as intent is lost."<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> has perceived karma and reentered the cycle of rebirth, yet the past is not forgotten and the spirit remains clear.<NL>Thus, he/she may once more enter the mortal world, retaining the visage from his/her former life...
e5c331da-ec32-482c-bba2-efa53d7396c4/Eve.cn: 所谓“有心无相，相逐心生；有相无心，相随心灭”，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />虽了悟因果，重入轮回，然前尘未忘，灵台不昧，<NL>故能依循前世相貌，再入红尘求觅菩提……
